tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the authenticated LeetCode user profile including username, premium status, and notification count.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a LeetCode user public profile by username. Returns real name, bio, ranking, company, school, and skill tags.

tools.name: get_user_progress
tools.description: Get question solving progress for a user broken down by difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard). Shows accepted, failed, and untouched counts.

tools.name: get_user_calendar
tools.description: Get a user submission calendar (heatmap data), current streak, total active days, and active years. Optionally filter by year.

tools.name: get_user_submit_stats
tools.description: Get detailed submission statistics for a user including total submissions, accepted count, and acceptance rate broken down by difficulty.

tools.name: get_user_badges
tools.description: Get badges earned by a user. Returns badge name, icon URL, and creation date.

tools.name: get_user_language_stats
tools.description: Get the programming languages a user has used for solving problems, with the number of problems solved in each language.

tools.name: get_user_skill_stats
tools.description: Get a user skill/topic tag statistics showing how many problems they have solved in each topic area, split by advanced, intermediate, and fundamental levels.

tools.name: list_problems
tools.description: List LeetCode problems with pagination. Optionally filter by category, difficulty, tags, status, and search keyword. Returns problem number, title, difficulty, acceptance rate, and topic tags.

tools.name: get_problem
tools.description: Get full details for a LeetCode problem including description (HTML), difficulty, hints, starter code snippets for all languages, similar questions, and example test cases.

tools.name: get_daily_challenge
tools.description: Get today daily coding challenge question including the date, link, and full problem metadata.

tools.name: get_problem_hints
tools.description: Get hints for a LeetCode problem. Returns an array of hint strings that progressively reveal the approach.

tools.name: get_problem_solution
tools.description: Get the official editorial/solution article for a problem. Returns the solution content in HTML format. Not all problems have official solutions.

tools.name: get_problem_stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a problem including total accepted/submitted counts, acceptance rate, and likes/dislikes. The stats field is a JSON string with totalAccepted, totalSubmission, totalAcceptedRaw, totalSubmissionRaw, and acRate.

tools.name: get_similar_problems
tools.description: Get problems similar to a given problem. Returns a list of related problems with their difficulty and paid-only status.

tools.name: get_code_snippets
tools.description: Get starter code templates for all available languages for a given problem. Returns the function signature and boilerplate for each language.

tools.name: list_topic_tags
tools.description: List all available topic tags (e.g., Array, Dynamic Programming, Graph). Use tag slugs with list_problems to filter problems by topic.

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: List your submissions with pagination. Optionally filter by problem slug. Returns submission ID, status, language, runtime, memory, and timestamp.

tools.name: list_recent_submissions
tools.description: List a user recent accepted submissions. Returns the most recent accepted solutions with problem title, language, and timestamp.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Get full details of a submission including source code, runtime/memory stats with percentiles, language, and any errors.

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run code against test cases for a LeetCode problem without submitting. Returns the output, expected output, runtime, memory, and whether the answer is correct. Use this to test solutions before submitting.

tools.name: submit_code
tools.description: Submit a solution for a LeetCode problem. Runs against all test cases and returns the verdict including status, runtime/memory percentiles, and any errors. Use run_code first to test your solution.

tools.name: list_discussions
tools.description: List discussion topics for a problem. Sorted by most votes by default. Returns topic title, view count, vote count, and creation date.

tools.name: get_contest_ranking
tools.description: Get a user contest rating, global ranking, number of contests attended, and top percentage.

tools.name: get_contest_history
tools.description: Get a user contest participation history. Returns each contest with the rating change, ranking, and whether the user attended.

tools.name: list_favorites
tools.description: List your LeetCode favorite/problem lists. Each list has a name, visibility, and a list of problem slugs saved in it.
